name: 34606 · Spring Hill, FL
findings: ZIP 34606 (Spring Hill) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34606 (Spring Hill) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34606 (Spring Hill) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).
